request: Analyze GSE319603 for PMID 41835150 (Transcriptomic insights into aerobic exercise-mediated attenuation of high-fat diet-induced muscle wasting.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (paired-end, STAR + featureCounts) of mouse gastrocnemius muscle
final.design_summary: Male C57BL/6J mice, 4 groups (C chow, CM chow+MICT, H HFD, HM HFD+MICT; n=12/group); HFD weeks 1-21, 8-week moderate-intensity continuous treadmill training weeks 14-21 (S2.1.p1, S2.2.p1). RNA-seq n=6/group on C, H and HM only (S2.7.p1, FIG3); CM was not sequenced.
final.sample_inclusion: 6 per group, C/H/HM; no exclusions stated
final.primary_estimand: Effect of 8-week MICT on gastrocnemius gene expression in HFD-fed mice (HM vs H); secondary: HFD effect in sedentary mice (H vs C)
planned_contrasts: HM vs H (exercise under HFD; S3.2.p1; paper: 563 DEGs, 213 up / 350 down)
H vs C (diet effect, not exercise; S3.2.p1; paper: 458 DEGs, 295 up / 163 down)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.22.2 on raw counts, BH FDR (S2.7.p1)
final.paper_results: Table 1 / Table 2 top-50 DEGs; GO (q<0.01) and KEGG (q<0.05) via clusterProfiler

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.7.p1 states DESeq2 on raw counts with BH FDR<0.05; S3.2.p1 adds the DEG rule adjusted P<0.05 and |log2FC| >= 0.5 and gives counts 458 (H vs C) and 563 (HM vs H). Exercise question maps to HM vs H; the chow exercise arm CM was not sequenced, so no exercise effect on chow or diet x exercise interaction can be estimated.

checks: GEO treatment_protocol matches the paper's 4-group MICT/HFD design
18 samples = 3 groups x 6, matching S2.7.p1 n=6 per group and FIG3 (C, H, HM)
tissue gastrocnemius, male C57BL/6J, featureCounts on GRCm38.p6 as in S2.7.p1

ownership.reasoning: Paper data availability statement names this accession and the metadata reproduce the paper's protocol and sample structure.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (C1..C6, H1..H6, HM1..HM6) equal the 'Library name' inside the GEO description field (18/18). Group letters come from the same library name and agree with GEO titles (control / high-fat diet / high-fat diet with MICT intervention).

final.source: GSE319603_All_gene_counts.csv (CSV conversion of the deposited xlsx)

matrix.reasoning: 100% integer values, range 0-3.3M, median 31; GEO data_processing says featureCounts and 'excel file includes raw counts for each sample'; paper S2.7.p1 says DESeq2 with raw counts as input.

final.analysis_type: multi-group, one model with planned pairwise contrasts

candidates.reason_rejected: confounds exercise with diet; not a paper contrast (run only as exploratory if the joint model lists it)
CM group not sequenced; interaction not identifiable

design.reasoning: Three independent groups, one factor. The exercise estimand is HM vs H (both HFD, differ only in MICT). H vs C is the paper's diet contrast, kept as secondary (not an exercise effect). One DESeq2 model on all 18 samples with planned contrasts.

covariance.reasoning: Independent animals, one sample each; all male, single time point, single tissue; no batch or lane recorded in GEO metadata.

deviations: pydeseq2 port instead of R DESeq2 1.22.2; joint 3-group model (paper's fitting scope - joint vs pairwise - not stated); a pairwise-subset DESeq2 sensitivity run is added for both contrasts

method.reasoning: Raw integer counts support the paper's DESeq2 route directly.

threshold.reasoning: S3.2.p1: adjusted P-value < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 0.5 (inclusive on the fold change). Audit: S2.7.p1 FDR<0.05 alone.

caveats: joint 3-group model; paper may have fitted pairwise
H vs C is a diet contrast, not an exercise effect
no CM sequencing: exercise effect on chow and diet x exercise interaction cannot be estimated

study.reasoning: Paper counts from S3.2.p1; named genes from Table 1/Table 2 and S3.5.p1 (Foxo1, Fbxo32, Trim63 down in HM vs H).

discrepancies.data: only C, H, HM sequenced (18 samples), consistent with FIG3

executions.name: joint
executions.reasoning: One DESeq2 ~grp model on all 18 samples; HM vs H is the exercise estimand, H vs C the paper's diet contrast.

executions.name: pair_HM_vs_H
executions.reasoning: Pairwise-subset DESeq2 in case the paper fitted each comparison separately.

executions.name: pair_H_vs_C
executions.reasoning: Pairwise-subset DESeq2 for the diet contrast.

enrichment.reasoning: Paper reports GO/KEGG for HM vs H DEGs (S3.3.p2, S3.4.p2).
